As Lowes Companies (LOW) Stock Price Declined, Capital Wealth Planning Trimmed Its Stake; Locust Wood Capital Advisers Increased Position in Apple (AAPL) by $19.47 Million as Market Value Declined
May 3, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Stephen J. Errico increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 59.46% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Locust Wood Capital Advisers Llc bought 115,230 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund run by Stephen J. Errico held 309,021 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $52.30M, up from 193,791 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Locust Wood Capital Advisers Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $899.57 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.41% or $0.72 during the last trading session, reaching $177.29. About 26.53M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 3, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Capital Wealth Planning Llc decreased its stake in Lowes Companies Inc (LOW) by 68.14% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Capital Wealth Planning Llc sold 27,804 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.74% with the market. The institutional investor held 13,000 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.21M, down from 40,804 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Capital Wealth Planning Llc who had been investing in Lowes Companies Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $68.37 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.38% or $1.16 during the last trading session, reaching $82.8. About 3.75M shares traded. Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE:LOW) has risen 5.39% since May 3, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.16% the S&P500.
Investors sentiment decreased to 1.01 in Q4 2017. Its down 0.03, from 1.04 in 2017Q3. It worsened, as 48 investors sold LOW shares while 437 reduced holdings. 138 funds opened positions while 351 raised stakes. 585.84 million shares or 0.67% less from 589.78 million shares in 2017Q3 were reported. Gardner Russo Gardner Ltd Liability Com has 300 shares. Edgemoor Invest Advisors holds 351,691 shares or 4.48% of its portfolio. Alphamark Advisors Ltd Company, a Kentucky-based fund reported 381 shares. Legacy Private Tru Co holds 0.07% or 6,347 shares in its portfolio. Fagan holds 2.41% of its portfolio in Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE:LOW) for 63,960 shares. Gofen & Glossberg Limited Liability Company Il invested 0.08% of its portfolio in Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE:LOW). Lord Abbett And Lc has invested 0.65% in Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE:LOW). Btr Mgmt Inc reported 130,781 shares. Swiss Savings Bank reported 3.09M shares or 0.31% of all its holdings. Wendell David Associate owns 28,575 shares for 0.46% of their portfolio. 2.26 million are held by Coho Limited. Sol Cap Mngmt reported 4,450 shares. Asset Mngmt Of Georgia Ga Adv holds 0.21% or 3,240 shares in its portfolio. Neuberger Berman Ltd Llc has invested 0.11% of its portfolio in Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE:LOW). Bridges Counsel Inc accumulated 8,660 shares.
Analysts await Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE:LOW) to report earnings on May, 23. They expect $1.29 earnings per share, up 25.24% or $0.26 from last year’s $1.03 per share. LOW’s profit will be $1.07B for 16.05 P/E if the $1.29 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.74 actual earnings per share reported by Lowe's Companies, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 74.32% EPS growth.
Capital Wealth Planning Llc, which manages about $380.53 million and $72.55 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Procter & Gamble Co (NYSE:PG) by 4,489 shares to 22,129 shares, valued at $2.03 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing.
Among 36 analysts covering Lowe’s Companies Inc. ( NYSE:LOW ), 23 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 13 Hold. Therefore 64% are positive. Locust Wood Capital Advisers Llc, which manages about $781.63M and $1.08B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Honeywell Intl Inc (NYSE:HON) by 22,900 shares to 214,534 shares, valued at $32.90 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Bank Amer Corp (NYSE:BAC) by 115,510 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 566,999 shares, and cut its stake in Star Group LP (NYSE:SGU).
